preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 1000, inclusive.
The length of the string is between 1 and 40, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: s consists of lowercase letters of the English alphabet
preconditions.description: The string consists of lowercase letters only.

postconditions.description: The output must be less than or equal to the length of the string.

postconditions.expression: exists k: 0 <= k <= n such that sorting(s[0:k] + s[k:]) == sorted(s)
postconditions.description: There exists a k such that by permuting the first k characters, the string can be sorted alphabetically.

postconditions.expression: for all k': 0 <= k' < output: not sorting(s[0:k'] + s[k':]) == sorted(s)
postconditions.description: The output is the minimum k such that permuting the first k characters results in a sorted string.
